Wholesale inflation is up 6%, the highest in 4 years, but Donald Trump does not care about your financial situation.

What is Trump thinking about instead? Himself, and his new ballroom.

NEWS: The Senate will hold votes on Trump’s undermining of key consumer protections against predatory corporate practices that raise costs and limit opportunity.

I'm leading a Joint Resolution of Disapproval against Trump's decision to reverse CFPB protections on mortgage lending because we cannot let Trump give a green light to bad actors to exploit potential homeowners.

The more Trump interferes with an independent Fed, the more chaos he injects into the markets.

With his disastrous war and failed economic agenda, Trump will only seek to exert more pressure on the Fed to manipulate interest rates to his own political advantage.

Appointing a new Fed chair amid this chaos would further undermine the Fed's independence.
“I don’t think about Americans’ financial situation. I don’t think about anyone.” – President Donald Trump

Trump has sunk at least $29 billion of American taxpayer money into a totally unnecessary war that has no endgame or strategic goals

Today’s vote was the 7th opportunity for the Senate GOP to support our resolution to withdraw troops from Iran, limit Trump’s ability to continue waging this war without authorization, and put an end to the economic fallout from this historic blunder—and they blocked it.

Operation Sledgehammer? 
 
There was never a deal on the table. There is no permanent ceasefire. Trump is hellbent on endless war in the Middle East. 
 
We will keep forcing War Powers Resolutions votes until enough Republicans grow a spine and vote with us to end this war for good.
